name: buckawn
text: buckawn is the anglicized form of the Gaelic Scotland word bòcan, the hobgoblin or household sprite of Highland tradition. MacKillop records this entry only as a one-line pointer, with no independent article body. The full record of the bòcan word-article sits under the headword bogan, and readers should follow that entry for definitions, regional variants, and related beings.
